dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you... sleeping with your eyes open?

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: I was... until you woke me up!

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: This is an act, you know. Something to fool my family, so that this night's rendezvous will not be exposed... Ahem.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: It's very impolite to wake someone when they're sleeping, so please refrain from doing it again. You won't find me to be as agreeable as my father... *yawn*
